Channel: alert-system (proxy — degraded mode, no Slack read path this session)  •  bug-type guess: env  •  alerts in group: 1

Symptoms:
  - DD monitor 227940275 "Redis Errors is High" fired 16:07:36Z, already self-recovered (OK by scan time)
  - Broken out by {service} (required — this monitor has a documented refutation history): gateway 4, nonprod/apps 2, default_web_site/syncapi 1 errors in the ~15-25min window. NOT concentrated on runtime-core-api.
  - KB match ki-2026-07-06-runtime-core-redis-cache-timeout-transient-burst REFUTED: its own evidence_query (Redis-timeout errors on runtime-core-api) returned 0 hits this cycle; only 1 stray "Redis operation cancelled" hit on runtime-core-api (single account), far below that entrys documented 20+-account shape.

Trace IDs: n/a — service:gateway/nonprod-apps/syncapi not DD-Logs-instrumented for status:error (same gap already documented under ki-21); metric-only signal, no representative trace id
Likely cause: Brief, low-magnitude Redis command-error blip spanning gateway (likely ms-gateway-api — critical-path service, JWT cache backing), nonprod/apps, and syncapi. Self-recovered. Root cause unknown; does not match any existing KB mechanism once broken out by service.
Suggested next action: monitor (self-recovered, no cascade evidence — no elevated gateway/auth latency or errors observed); flag for a new KB entry if this shape recurs

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-07-runtime-core-expiresessiontoken-accountnotfound`
This is occurrence #4 (last_notified_at 2026-07-24T13:22:19Z, ~4d4h ago — exceeded the 24h suppression window).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Vertical App Experience` (`@sales management` / `#team-sales-management`)
Playbook: Confirm via ES fields.dd_service.keyword:"runtime-core-api" AND message.keyword:"Session Token Expiry Failed"; read a full sample record's exceptions[0] to confirm AccountNotFoundExceptions via AccountContext.InitAsync <- ActionContext.InitAsync <- SecurityController.ExpireSessionTokenAsync; aggregate by fields.AdditionalMetaData.keyword to confirm single-session concentration.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack read path this session (DD monitor scan-diff proxy; surfaced during investigation of DD monitor 227940275 "Redis Errors is High", which itself was refuted for this fire — see investigation doc)

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/227940275 (the triggering alert — refuted as this KB's cause, see below)
  • DD logs: n/a — this signature is ES-sourced, not DD-Logs
  • Kibana: ES query fields.dd_service.keyword:"runtime-core-api" AND message.keyword:"Session Token Expiry Failed", 16:32:35-16:37:35Z confirmed 4/4 hits via es_search.py this cycle, single session (email: anthony.s@lappstructures.com, accountName empty), 16:37:11-16:37:23Z (~12s span) — identical shape to the 2 prior confirmed occurrences
  • This-window concentration: 100% single-session (1 email, 4/4 hits) — client-retry pattern, not a platform-wide issue
  • Note: the triggering monitor (227940275 "Redis Errors is High") was independently investigated and REFUTED against ki-2026-07-06-runtime-core-redis-cache-timeout-transient-burst — its exact 5-min eval window showed only 1 Redis command error (on gateway, not runtime-core-api), far below its own >10 threshold. This ExpireSessionToken signature was the only genuine ES-corroborated finding in the same window, unrelated to Redis. Full reasoning in docs/investigations/2026-07-29-b173d143c3b438c4.md.
